definition: The rule could not be tested on this house: a measurement it needs is missing, or the tool that would take it is absent. Unjudged is not passed, and it is never counted as a pass.
basis: VISION.md section VII names it the rule the project would least survive breaking: "Every check distinguishes evaluated-and-failed, evaluated-and-passed", "This is the single rule the project would least survive breaking." mcp_server/core.py check_measurements reports the faults "which it could not judge because a number is missing". build/check_all.py, for a check whose optional tool is not installed: "It is reported distinctly and does not fail the" build, "but it is never printed as OK — unjudged is not passed."
